results.title: PBF Energy Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2024 (Annual Financial Statement Tables - full year 2024)
results.snippet: The refineries produce unbranded transportation fuels, heating oil, petrochemical feedstocks, lubricants, and other petroleum products in the United States.

results.title: PBF Energy Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2022 (Annual Financial Statement Tables - full year 2022)
results.snippet: The company's 10-K says it sells across the Northeast, Midwest, Gulf Coast and West Coast, and also ships to Canada and Mexico and can reach other international destinations.

results.title: PBF Logistics
results.snippet: It provides rail, truck and marine terminaling, pipeline transportation and storage services to PBF Holding and its subsidiaries and to third-party customers under fee-based commercial agreements.

results.title: PBF Energy Strategy and Business Model
results.snippet: A third-party profile lists gasoline, diesel, jet fuel, heating oil, asphalt, petrochemical feedstocks and renewable diesel as key products, and says pricing is mostly market-based rather than contractually recurring.

results.title: PBF Energy Inc. - Form 10-K - FY2019 (Annual Financial Statement Tables - full year 2019)
results.snippet: Products are marketed to customers in the United States and abroad through a network of dealers and wholesalers, and PBF has no company-owned or branded retail outlets.
